translation_notes: EXCLUDED for executability, not for notation: the region is an integration test of virtuoso-python's SQLAlchemy-to-RDF quad mapping. It needs the 'virtuoso' package plus its ODBC driver, 'sqla_rdfbridge', a 2014-era SQLAlchemy (sqlalchemy.ext.declarative.api, as_declarative(bind=...)), 'nose', AND a live Virtuoso server -- setup_class declares an RDF view in it, session.commit() writes rows through it, and the closing assertion reads the mapped triples back out. Everything the assertion observes is produced by the server; no fixture can stand in for it without re-implementing the mapping engine, which would validate the double instead of the region. The driver is kept and its verdict carries the exact import error (No module named 'virtuoso').

the translation itself is a plain notation change and was verified by transpilation: the two TST.cname occurrences become tst:cname, in an argument position of VirtuosoQuadMapPattern(...) and inside the triple pattern of graph.triples((None, tst:cname, None)); both resolve to <http://example.com/test#cname> in the emitted code. Prefixed names outside islands work in both operand positions, so nothing here is awkward.

TST = Namespace('http://example.com/test#') disappears from the ldpy side, replaced by @prefix tst: . In the real module TST is also read by MyClassPatternExtractor (getattr(TST, 'col_pattern_%s_%s' % ...)) OUTSIDE the extracted region -- a dynamic local name that @prefix cannot serve, so the full file would have to keep the Namespace object alongside the prefix declaration. Worth recording: this is the @prefix/Namespace duplication problem in a real file.

the mechanical draft was broken and was rewritten: it had inserted the @prefix line INSIDE the parenthesised 'from virtuoso.vmapping import (' statement. The declaration now sits after the module-level statements, where its lexical scope covers the function below.

original.py is left exactly as extracted (its 'Session' and 'B'/'C' globals belong to the surrounding module and were not part of the region); no shim was invented for it, since a shim could not make the assertion meaningful.
